newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well established, compared with Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow. Demand and seller interest mostly light. Offerings were light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales. Heifers - Select and Choice 2-4 075-1150 lbs few 66.00-67.75 ld 65.50.
